results.description: Symptom routing safety valve: when narrowing fails to converge after several vague exchanges, fire render_book_service with diagnostic_scan + diagnostic_system='not_sure' (per the polite-exit rule). Sprint 4 Day 1 Pass B §4 dispatch (booking-flow consolidation; render_book_service). RE-AUTHORED + RE-ENABLED 2026-08-14: originally 6 turns for the threshold-4 era, and DISABLED because the polite-exit counter sat inside the skipPersist gate — the harness could never increment it, so the block never fired and the case could never pass. The counter now runs on harness turns and POLITE_EXIT_THRESHOLD=2 enforces the three-state deadline server-side: two unconverged question-turns, the third turn carries <polite_exit_required> and must conclude.
